Senses.PreferredTarget: a golden buddha does not pass through the furnace
AlternateTargets: the golden buddha cannot survive the furnace
Senses.Explanation: The first member of the material-buddha test: a golden buddha does not survive passage through a smelting furnace. Yulin Tongxiu and Miyun Yuanwu actively raise the saying, while Zhaozhou Congshen supplies the inherited higher-tier recorded-sayings family.
Senses.Note: The furnace is selected for gold in the same way that fire and water test the wooden and clay figures in the full formula.
